June newsletter

Hey Pablo,

Back when I first started here, I wrote an article on using Capsule for 
your fundraising efforts.

Well, after running my first half-marathon on Sunday (very subtle humble 
brag, right?) I was feeling pretty sore, smug, and not really ready to 
start my working week. Scrolling through my inbox, I found a Capsule 
email reminder:

Screenshot of Capsule reminder email reads

I’d made dummy Sales Pipelines and Project boards to illustrate how you 
can plan charitable events and manage fundraising in Capsule! It was an 
eerie but satisfying, full-circle moment.

All this to say, did you know you can use Capsule to plan and manage 
events? Pair that with a Pipeline for sourcing donations, and you’ve got 
yourself a well-oiled fundraising machine.

This doesn’t just apply to charities. If you’re looking for an easier 
way to manage events or raise funds, check out these pieces:


      How does a CRM help you manage donations?

Donor relationships aren't all that different from customer 
relationships. Keep track of conversations, follow-ups, pledges, and key 
supporters without relying on a collection of spreadsheets and crossed 
fingers. *Learn more↗* 
<https://tracking.capsulecrm.com/c/7c63e7fa2427197139099ae96e61a969_24c2bb9f969dc01b0dde5be76e1a8e12?sid=0a657a9f8bdc5f59b6d0668295f8220d_96a2e35b28cbab532d9cc3a249668710&aid=E3bQ>


      How to use Projects to run an event

Whether you're organising a charity gala, networking breakfast, or 
community fundraiser, there are always a hundred moving parts. Here's 
how to keep deadlines, tasks, suppliers, and volunteers organised in one 
place.

*Discover Projects for running events↗* 
<https://tracking.capsulecrm.com/c/9726c3d862ac1929ad465a9d522b95fe_f88a4d2ea262ccc51dd6032c54da2a3d?sid=0a657a9f8bdc5f59b6d0668295f8220d_96a2e35b28cbab532d9cc3a249668710&aid=E3bQ>


      How to use your CRM for event management with Capsule
